name: RALU NT-DM schedule fit
plain: Fits per-stage shifts so the mixed-resolution schedule spends time where the normal schedule would, measured by Jensen-Shannon distance on a 1000 point grid. Used only when you give custom stage steps and ends; presets carry the fitted numbers. Needs scipy.
math:
q_h(t)=h/(1+(h−1)t)². Each stage covers [s_k,e_k] with N_k steps.
Target p=(q_h₀+Σ_k (e_k−s_{k+1})·q_h₀|[s_{k+1},e_k])/(1+Σ(e_k−s_{k+1})).
Schedule Q=Σ N_k q_{h_k}|[s_k,e_k] /ΣN.
Minimise JS(p,Q) over h₁..₃∈[.5,10], Z∈[2,100], start [3,3,3,2].
Stage σ: linear in σ between warps of 1−s_k and 1−e_k.
label: from code
surprise: ralu_engine.compute_ralu_params takes total_steps and never uses it, while the near-copy in ralu_flux_runtime.py rescales N to it.
